title: Integral constructibility detected by actual residue reduction
statement:
theorem internal_integral_residue_criterion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X K ↔
        IsDerivedComplete l E X K ∧
        constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E 1) X
          ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X 0).obj K) ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _
          ((AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X 0).obj K)) ∧
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X =
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X ⊓
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X))
All objects and maps use the actual continuous internal coefficient objects; quotient index zero is exponent one.

source.place: Conclusion and input constructibility paragraphs; the internal presentation of the integral-models criterion

proof.text: Transport the integral bounded constructibility predicate along the canonical pointComparison, using scalar-restriction equivalence, homology naturality and constant-model invariance. Apply integral_models_stacks, identify its completeness clause by internal_completion_stacks_comparison and its residue clause by internal_residue_stacks_comparison. This gives the first equivalence.

The theorem integral_constant_local_tor gives [-1,0] for every finite constant local model over the actual integral coefficient. The stratified Tor devissage applies this interval to each constructible cohomology module. Choose a bounded cohomological interval and apply torAmplitudeIn_of_cohomology_interval to obtain a finite Tor interval for the whole complex. Predicate extensionality then proves Dbc = Dbc meet finiteTor.

proof_origin.place: G7: split actual completion and residue comparisons; reuse the proved stratified and bounded-cohomology Tor devissage; prove the arbitrary-universe DVR local Tor lemma.
